verdict.rationale: Meltano's CLI and pipeline model (meltano run, meltano add, stream/property selection, config across plugins) allow scripted, repeatable operations across many extractors/loaders/streams in a single project, which supports bulk-style automation, but there is no evidence of an 'AI-native' interface, natural-language bulk operation, or explicit batch/bulk API for acting across many items at once beyond standard CLI scripting. missing for 10: explicit bulk-operation tooling or AI-native batch interface, evidence of large-scale simultaneous multi-item operations, independent confirmation of bulk automation at scale.
